candidates.name: Building Engines
candidates.description: Building Engines is a property management software platform designed for commercial real estate (CRE) professionals. It streamlines operations by offering tools for managing work orders, tenant compliance, risk management, vendor management, and space and leasing plans. Key features include AI-powered insights for building performance, mobile access for tenants, and automated reporting to enhance efficiency and reduce costs in real estate transactions. The platform aims to improve overall productivity and tenant satisfaction through streamlined workflows and data analysis.

Their main functionality includes automating processes such as underwriting, investor reporting, lease abstraction, due diligence, and property management through tools like ChatGPT and Gemini. They work collaboratively with clients to develop tailored AI workflows that enhance efficiency and effectiveness in various aspects of real estate operations, including multifamily investment strategies and property oversight. The network also offers consulting services to help teams implement these AI systems effectively.

The platform allows users to manage multiple properties from one centralized interface, generate detailed proposals, and analyze data to enhance decision-making and operational efficiency across various real estate sectors, including office, retail, and industrial.

candidates.name: The Hour
candidates.description: The Hour offers AI-powered virtual assistants that help businesses manage their administrative and operational tasks efficiently. Their VAs are trained to handle various areas such as e-commerce, insurance operations, payroll, customer support, and more, allowing clients to focus on growth while they handle the core workflows. The service includes a month-to-month contract model with no long-term contracts, personalized staffing plans, and integration of AI tools for improved performance. Clients can choose from different subscription packages based on their specific needs and budget.
candidates.rationale: The Hour provides general virtual-assistant staffing services, not commercial-real-estate leasing, asset management, tenant experience, or property-data software.

candidates.name: REinnovation
candidates.description: REinnovation is a platform that provides tools and services for real estate agencies to enhance their operations. It offers features such as digital marketing, customer management, and training programs aimed at improving agency performance throughout the entire process of acquisition and sale. Members benefit from exclusive access to tools, personalized support, and ongoing updates on market trends and regulations. The platform also includes specialized services like web marketing, content writing, and loyalty program management to help agents effectively manage client relationships and maximize sales opportunities.
candidates.rationale: REinnovation serves residential real estate agencies with marketing, CRM, and training, not commercial property owners managing leasing, assets, and tenant experience.

candidates.name: Deal Manager AI
candidates.description: Deal Manager is an AI-powered platform designed to streamline the commercial real estate (CRE) transaction process from sourcing and execution to closing deals quickly. It offers a suite of tools for various asset classes, including multifamily, retail, healthcare, and industrial properties, allowing users to analyze property data, manage budgets, and visualize deal pipelines in 3D. Key features include automated model development, integration with existing systems like Outlook and HubSpot, and customizable workflows that enhance collaboration among teams and clients throughout the entire lifecycle of real estate transactions.
candidates.rationale: Both provide CRE teams with transaction workflow, pipeline, and property-data software, overlapping particularly in leasing and deal management.

candidates.name: HelloData
candidates.description: HelloData is a platform designed to automate market research for multifamily real estate professionals. It allows users to create automated market surveys, track unit-level rents, and analyze financial data quickly and efficiently. Key features include customizable report formats, AI-generated insights, daily updates on leasing activity, and the ability to generate reports in real-time using Excel or CSV format. The platform supports various stakeholders including investors, developers, brokers, and real estate managers, providing tools for effective communication and analysis of market trends.
candidates.rationale: Both provide B2B real-estate software for leasing and property-market intelligence, serving overlapping investors, brokers, developers, and property managers.

candidates.name: Fair Leases
candidates.description: Fair Leases is a workflow tool designed to streamline lease management for landlords and tenants. It allows users to upload leases, generate lease drafts, and manage legal notices quickly, often within minutes. Key features include AI-powered analysis of lease conditions, customizable templates, secure document storage, and automated renewal notifications, all aimed at improving efficiency and reducing legal costs in leasing processes.
candidates.rationale: Both provide lease-management workflows for landlords/property operators, including lease administration, document handling, and renewals.

candidates.name: Scilytix
candidates.description: Scilytix offers a real estate analytics platform called PropStatsIQ, designed to enhance decision-making for real estate professionals, investors, and landlords. The platform provides tools for accurate property valuations, personalized analytics, and investment tracking through proprietary PSIQ scoring and TensorFlow models. Key features include instant valuation models, market analysis, rental metrics, and an interactive dashboard that allows users to track investments and tenant performance in real estate transactions efficiently.
candidates.rationale: Both provide real-estate owners and investors with property analytics, portfolio tracking, and decision-support tools for asset management.

candidates.name: Facilio
candidates.description: Facilio AI offers a suite of cloud-based facility management software designed to automate various operations within property management systems. The platform includes tools for service request management, reporting, invoice verification, and asset life cycle management, all aimed at improving operational efficiency and reducing costs. Key features include automated helpdesk automation, energy monitoring, visitor management, and integration with existing security systems, allowing users to manage their own assets efficiently from anywhere.
candidates.rationale: Both provide cloud software for commercial property operators, overlapping in asset management, tenant services, and property operations workflows.

candidates.name: MultifamilyOS
candidates.description: MultifamilyOS is an AI-powered platform designed for multifamily investors to manage their investment businesses efficiently. It offers features such as property searches, deal management tools, automated outreach campaigns, and a built-in AI property coach for personalized insights. Users can streamline their investment processes through a unified system that integrates various functionalities, including document generation, asset management, and investor engagement, all aimed at improving efficiency and closing deals faster.
candidates.rationale: MultifamilyOS targets residential investors and acquisition workflows, while VTS serves commercial-property teams managing leasing, assets, and tenant operations.

candidates.name: Real Estate Pro Desk
candidates.description: Real Estate Pro Desk is a membership platform designed to support real estate professionals in their careers. It offers access to educational resources, including templates for home management and marketing strategies, as well as case studies and training programs aimed at enhancing agent skills and career advancement. Members can benefit from personalized mentorship, access to exclusive content, and tools that streamline their workflows and improve client engagement. The platform also provides free resources tailored for both agents and property managers across the United States.
candidates.rationale: Real Estate Pro Desk provides education and mentorship for agents, not commercial real-estate leasing, asset-management, or tenant-experience software.

candidates.name: Facility Executive
candidates.description: Facility Executive is a publication that provides news, trends, and resources for facility management teams. It covers various topics including building design, safety, energy efficiency, and technology solutions in commercial facilities. The website features articles, webinars, case studies, and product information to help members improve their maintenance practices and operational effectiveness. Additionally, it offers tools like an interactive map and access to industry-specific reports on specific facility needs.
candidates.rationale: Facility Executive is an industry publication, not a commercial real estate operating platform for leasing, asset management, or tenant experience.

candidates.name: Property Innovation Journal
candidates.description: Property Innovation Journal is a publication focused on real estate technology and market trends. It provides articles, insights, and analysis on various topics including artificial intelligence tools, construction efficiency, and market intelligence. Key features include profiles of professionals in the real estate industry, insights into emerging technologies like AI-driven marketing strategies, and coverage of significant changes in the buying and selling process. The site also offers newsletters for subscribers to receive the latest updates on real Estate developments and innovations.
candidates.rationale: Property Innovation Journal is a real-estate technology publication, not a commercial-property operating platform for leasing, asset management, or tenant experience.

candidates.name: StackDC
candidates.description: StackDC offers AI-driven automation solutions for real estate operations, focusing on reducing manual data entry and improving cash collection. Their platform includes a no-code business automation center that automates tasks such as contract creation, invoice processing, and reporting through an open-API system. Key features include OCR technology for automatic data extraction from documents, intelligent chatbots for customer inquiries, and customizable KPI performance dashboards. StackDC aims to enhance operational efficiency across various industries by streamlining workflows and enhancing data management.
candidates.rationale: Both provide B2B software for real-estate operations teams, overlapping workflow automation, property data, reporting, and operational-efficiency use cases.

candidates.name: AIgent Realty
candidates.description: AIgent Realty offers a platform that provides AI-powered tools for real estate professionals to streamline their workflows. Its main functionalities include managing residential and commercial property portfolios, automating routine tasks, and facilitating deal closings through intelligent agents. Key features include portfolio optimization, risk assessment, tenant relationship management, legal guidance, and financial management, all designed to enhance productivity and decision-making in the real estate industry.
candidates.rationale: Both provide software for real estate professionals managing commercial property portfolios, tenant relationships, workflows, risk, and operational decision-making.

candidates.name: CRE Success Stories
candidates.description: CRE Success Stories offers an AI-powered toolkit designed for commercial real estate brokers and agents. Its main purpose is to enhance marketing, listing strategies, and generating leads without the need for extensive hours or lengthy cold outreach. Key features include a buyer Avatar Builder for mapping ideal buyers, a market report generator that generates insights from property statistics, a CoPilot tool for crafting effective pitch decks and social media content, and a Lead Magnet Creator for generating inbound leads. The platform aims to streamline marketing efforts and improve overall sales performance for commercial professionals.
candidates.rationale: CRE Success Stories is a broker marketing and lead-generation toolkit, not a leasing, asset-management, tenant-experience, or property-operations platform like VTS.

candidates.name: American Realty Advisors
candidates.description: American Realty Advisors (ARA) is a real estate investment management firm that focuses on creating value for investors through data-driven strategies. They offer services in asset and advisory management, focusing on core, value-add, and debt investing across various sectors such as industrial, residential, retail, and office properties. ARA also provides insights through research and market commentary, aiming to support clients in navigating the U.S. real estate market while ensuring effective communication and collaboration with partners.
candidates.rationale: American Realty Advisors is an investment manager and potential VTS customer, not a commercial-real-estate operating software platform.

candidates.name: Dealpath
candidates.description: Dealpath is a real estate deal management software that integrates data, AI, and automation to streamline the entire process of buying, selling, and refinancing properties. Its main functionalities include real-time deal tracking, pipeline management, relationship management, and CRM tools for managing relationships with investors and brokers. Key features also encompass market trends analysis, automated deal execution workflows, and customizable dashboards for informed decision-making across various asset types and funds.
candidates.rationale: Both serve commercial real estate firms, but Dealpath manages investment transactions, not VTS’s core leasing, asset operations, or tenant experience workflows.

candidates.name: REI Automations
candidates.description: REI Automations provides tools designed for real estate investors to enhance their acquisitions, operations, and lead generation. The platform integrates with ChatGPT technology for streamlined communication and offers a customizable CRM system that allows users to manage multiple websites from various providers like WordPress and Carrot. Key features include automated follow-up processes, transparent reporting, and the ability to create dynamic marketing campaigns, all aimed at improving efficiency and closing deals within 24 hours. Users can choose between self-hosting or integrating existing systems to streamline their process.
candidates.rationale: REI Automations serves property investors with acquisition lead-generation and CRM tools, not commercial leasing, asset management, or tenant-experience operations.

candidates.name: Engrain
candidates.description: Engrain offers interactive mapping solutions designed to enhance tenant engagement and improve leasing success for property management. Its main product, SightMap, allows users to view detailed pricing information on rental rates across various properties, including multifamily apartments and senior living options. Additionally, Engrain provides Asset Intelligence tools that provide insights, data visualization, and strategic decision-making through its TouchTour feature. The platform also includes integrations with over 1,000 partner platforms to streamline the leasing process and support comprehensive asset management needs.
candidates.rationale: Engrain’s interactive property mapping supports leasing, but it is a complementary visualization tool, not a commercial real estate leasing and asset-management platform.

candidates.name: Ecotrak
candidates.description: Ecotrak is a facility management software designed to streamline operations for various industries, including healthcare and retail. Its main functionalities include asset management, work order management, parts and inventory management, and a service provider directory. Key features also encompass automated purchase ordering, technician dispatch, predictive intelligence, and AI-driven decision-making to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime. The platform supports both front-of-house and back-office teams, allowing them to efficiently manage service requests and improve overall operational efficiency.
candidates.rationale: Ecotrak manages facility maintenance and work orders, while VTS centers on commercial real-estate leasing, asset strategy, tenant experience, and property data.

candidates.name: BoldTrail
candidates.description: BoldTrail is a real estate platform that offers AI-powered tools and solutions for agents, teams, and brokers. Its main functionalities include an integrated CRM, back office management, recruitment services, transaction integration, and business analytics. Key features include a mobile app for lead generation, automated commissions, and customizable add-ons like PropertyBoost, which enhances client engagement and retention. The platform aims to streamline workflows and improve productivity across various industries in the real estate industry.
candidates.rationale: BoldTrail serves real estate agents and brokerages with CRM and transaction tools; VTS serves commercial property owners/operators managing leasing and assets.

candidates.name: LeaseCreditS.com
candidates.description: LeaseCreditS.com is a platform that connects landlords and tenants with verified rental services across over 1,100 verified service domains. Users can submit their needs, and the platform matches them with professionals who offer services such as tenant screening, lease review, move-in coordination, and property management. The service emphasizes privacy by not sharing client information and ensuring transparency in pricing.
candidates.rationale: LeaseCreditS is a rental-services matching marketplace, not a commercial real-estate operating platform for leasing, asset management, tenant experience, and property data.

candidates.name: VirtualEdge VA Solutions
candidates.description: VirtualEdge VA Solutions offers digital tools designed to help small businesses manage various operational tasks efficiently. Their services include ready-made content packs, AI-powered summaries, and personalized email management tailored for specific industries such as social media and customer support. Users can choose a product or service, receive ready-to-use content within 24 hours, and access resources like a free VA Delegation Guide to streamline communication. The company aims to save time and reduce costs while enhancing productivity for its clients.
candidates.rationale: VirtualEdge provides virtual-assistant productivity services, not commercial-real-estate leasing, asset management, tenant experience, or property-data software.

candidates.name: Retrack AI
candidates.description: Retrack is an AI-powered platform designed for property management, focusing on lease and portfolio management. It automates processes such as invoicing, financial reconciliations, and tenant relationship management through a single dashboard. Key features include real-time tracking of transactions, automated lease management with alerts for important deadlines, and integration with various accounting software like Yardi and Sage. The platform also offers analytics and a chat assist to enhance user experience and streamline operations for commercial real estate owners and tenants.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate software for lease and portfolio management, serving property owners and managers with overlapping operational workflows.

candidates.name: Allegro
candidates.description: Allegro is a commercial real estate brokerage and advisory firm that assists clients in transactions, leasing, and management of their properties. Their main services include transaction advisory, portfolio management, facility management, and consulting to help organizations optimize their real estate portfolios. Allegro also offers tailored solutions for various industries such as healthcare, finance, and government, focusing on strategic planning and operational excellence.
candidates.rationale: Allegro is a brokerage and real-estate advisory services firm, not a commercial real-estate operating software platform evaluated for the same job.

candidates.name: WorkInSync
candidates.description: WorkInSync is a workplace management software designed to streamline various operations within organizations. Its main functionality includes desk booking, meeting room management, visitor management, parking management, and floor kiosk automation. Key features include real-time availability tracking, automated access control, customizable workspace layouts, and analytics for optimizing office space usage and productivity. The platform integrates with existing systems and offers tailored solutions for different industries, including hybrid work environments and enterprise ready platforms.
candidates.rationale: WorkInSync serves corporate workplace and facilities teams, while VTS primarily serves commercial property owners managing leasing, assets, tenants, and property data.

candidates.name: CRES Technology
candidates.description: CRES Technology provides a variety of IT services and software solutions tailored for small and mid-sized businesses. Their offerings include Virtual Chief Information Officer (VOC) services, infrastructure support, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365 support, and software development. Additionally, they offer specialized software solutions such as document management, contract management, legal entity management, and real estate software to streamline operations and enhance productivity. CRES also specializes in staff augmentation to connect companies with skilled professionals for their technology needs.
candidates.rationale: CRES is primarily an IT services and staff-augmentation provider; its generic real-estate software does not clearly overlap VTS’s CRE operating platform.

candidates.name: Multifamily University
candidates.description: Multifamily University offers educational resources and tools for real estate investors, focusing on market trends, investment strategies, and best practices. The main product, Location Magic, provides insights into the latest property trends and investment opportunities in various markets, including multifamily properties and commercial real estate. Key features include webinars, podcasts, and a community platform called Investor Club that delivers updates on investments and market developments.
candidates.rationale: Multifamily University provides investor education and market insights, not a commercial real-estate leasing, asset management, and tenant-experience operating platform.

candidates.name: Remarkably
candidates.description: Remarkably is a marketing business intelligence software designed for multifamily operators to analyze and report on their property performance. It aggregates data from various platforms, including Property Management Software, CRM, and Google Analytics, into a single view of channel and leasing costs. Key features include automated reporting, trend insights, interactive dashboards, and AI-driven analysis to identify issues before they escalate, allowing users to make informed decisions and improve overall efficiency in their marketing efforts.
candidates.rationale: Remarkably provides multifamily marketing analytics, while VTS centers on commercial leasing and asset operations; buyers and primary jobs-to-be-done differ.

candidates.name: Pete REI
candidates.description: Pete REI Software is a CRM platform designed specifically for real estate investors. It streamlines operations by automating workflows, managing leads and deals, and tracking deal status through integrated e-signatures and phone and SMS integration. Key features include data analytics, customizable dashboards, automated follow-up systems, and the ability to capture leads from multiple sources, all aimed at enhancing efficiency and decision-making in real estate investing.
candidates.rationale: Pete REI serves real estate investors’ lead acquisition workflows, not commercial landlords’ leasing, asset management, or tenant operations.

candidates.name: MRI Software
candidates.description: MRI Software provides intelligent property management solutions for various sectors, including residential, commercial, and public housing. Its main functionality includes managing leasing, financials, tenant payments, facility management, and energy operations through a single platform that integrates AI-driven insights. Key features include automated data accessibility, risk and fraud management, customizable user experiences, and comprehensive reporting tools to enhance operational efficiency and decision-making. The software is designed to streamline processes across multiple industries, helping property owners manage their assets effectively.
candidates.rationale: MRI offers overlapping commercial real-estate leasing, property management, tenant, financial, and asset operations software to the same property-owner and manager buyers.

candidates.name: StackPlanner
candidates.description: StackPlanner is a cloud-based software designed for real estate professionals to manage lease and occupancy data efficiently. It allows users to track vacancies, lease expiries, and opportunities in real time through a visual dashboard that provides insights from various sources. Key features include the ability to import existing data, create interactive product tours, and facilitate team collaboration to streamline decision-making across different teams. The platform aims to improve property performance and reduce vacancy time by 30% across buildings.
candidates.rationale: Both provide B2B commercial real estate software for managing leasing, occupancy, vacancies, and property performance for real estate professionals.

candidates.name: SpecSavi
candidates.description: SpecSavi is a service provider that specializes in revenue strategy, technology integration, and automation for B2B SaaS companies. It helps teams build AI-enabled revenue systems across various functions such as CRM, marketing, sales operations, and customer success. Key features include custom revenue engine design, automated workflows, data management, and ongoing support to ensure efficient operation of revenue systems. SpecSavi also offers tailored solutions for specific business needs, leveraging its expertise in platforms like HubSpot and Salesforce to enhance revenue performance.
candidates.rationale: SpecSavi is a revenue-operations consultancy for SaaS companies, not a commercial-real-estate leasing, asset management, or tenant-experience software platform.

candidates.name: Booking Buddy
candidates.description: Booking Buddy is a rental management app designed for property owners and renters. It allows users to set pricing, manage bookings, accept payments, and communicate with guests through a centralized messaging center. Key features include dynamic pricing based on demand and seasonality, real-time availability updates, performance analytics, and customizable pricing rules. The app can be embedded on existing websites and offers various subscription plans tailored to different business needs.
candidates.rationale: Booking Buddy manages short-term rental bookings and guest payments, while VTS serves commercial real-estate teams managing leasing, assets, and tenants.

candidates.name: Kinexio
candidates.description: Kinexio is a platform designed to enhance commercial property management across various asset classes, including retail, office, and mixed-use properties. Its main functionality includes improving tenant engagement, streamlining operations, and ensuring safety through advanced security measures like NFC tags and real estate analytics. Key features include automated communication with tenants, data collection for informed decision-making, and integration with other systems to reduce operational costs and improve overall efficiency.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial-property operating software focused on tenant engagement, property operations, integrations, and analytics for real-estate owners and managers.

candidates.name: invstg
candidates.description: Invstg is a platform designed for real estate investors, sellers, and buyers to connect directly with investors and property owners in off-market markets. It allows users to list properties, access investment opportunities, and manage their portfolios efficiently while ensuring confidentiality and data security. Key features include built-in deal calculators for evaluating investment returns, automated notifications for new listings, secure communication tools for confidential discussions, and customizable reporting capabilities to track portfolio performance.
candidates.rationale: Invstg is an off-market property marketplace for investors, not a commercial real estate leasing, tenant-experience, and asset-operations platform.

candidates.name: Real Estate Resources
candidates.description: Real Estate Resources offers property management, real estate sales, and leasing services to landlords, investors, and property owners. Their main functionalities include tenant placement, lease administration, maintenance and inspections, marketing for sales and leasing, and financial reporting. They provide end-to-end solutions tailored to the entire lifecycle of real estate ownership, ensuring efficient management and growth for their clients.
candidates.rationale: Real Estate Resources is a property management and brokerage service, not a commercial real estate operating software platform evaluated for the same job.

candidates.name: Ditenso GmbH
candidates.description: Ditenso is a technology solutions provider specializing in real estate management, advisory services, and IT security. The company offers a range of products including an integrated workplace management system (IWMS), risk management systems, and analytics tools to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. Key features include automated reporting, integration with ServiceNow for seamless operations, and the ability to manage multiple teams efficiently while ensuring compliance with regulations like NIS2. Diten so also provides training programs and resources to support businesses in their digital transformation efforts.
candidates.rationale: Ditenso is primarily an IT consultancy/integrator; its IWMS and security services do not clearly compete with VTS’s commercial leasing and asset platform.

candidates.name: LeaseMagnets
candidates.description: LeaseMagnets is a virtual sales concierge platform designed for property managers to enhance their leasing efforts. It allows users to create and manage live guided tours, automate lead generation through AI, and utilize advanced analytics to optimize marketing strategies. Key features include the ability to co- Browse or live call prospects, share detailed tours across various properties, and integrate with existing tools like CRM systems and email marketing platforms. The platform aims to improve conversion rates and streamline the leasing process for agents.
candidates.rationale: LeaseMagnets targets multifamily residential leasing teams, while VTS serves commercial real estate owners and brokers; their buyers and leasing workflows differ.

candidates.name: AcquiZen AI
candidates.description: AcquiZen is an AI-powered platform designed for real estate wholesalers to streamline the deal discovery, analysis, and closing process. It offers features such as a Zen Score System that evaluates property opportunities with over 50 data points, AI-filtered seller leads, and real-time performance tracking through an analytics dashboard. The platform also includes team management tools, automated notifications, and integration with verified buyers and investors, all aimed at enhancing efficiency and decision-making in real estate transactions.
candidates.rationale: AcquiZen serves real estate wholesalers with deal sourcing and analysis, not commercial property operators managing leasing, assets, and tenant experience.

candidates.name: Escoutly
candidates.description: Escoutly is an AI-powered real estate platform that provides insights and personalized recommendations for buyers, sellers, and investors. It offers features such as intelligent property matching, market analysis, integrated CRM tools, and interactive neighborhood maps to help users make informed decisions about their real estate journey. The platform also facilitates seamless transactions through a digital transaction management system and integrates with various industry partners to enhance user experience.
candidates.rationale: Escoutly targets property buyers, sellers, and investors, not commercial landlords managing leasing, assets, tenant experience, and property operations.

candidates.name: Rentametrix
candidates.description: Rentametrix offers a suite of tools designed for property managers in student housing. The main functionality includes tracking leasing activity, analyzing market trends, and optimizing pricing structures through customizable dashboards. Key features include the Lease Activity Tracker, Market Survey Manager, Rate Tier Calculator, and various subscription plans tailored for small properties, large management companies, and larger housing providers. These tools aim to streamline operations, improve decision-making, and enhance overall efficiency in leasing processes.
candidates.rationale: Rentametrix targets student-housing property managers, while VTS serves commercial real-estate leasing and asset teams; buyers and property workflows differ materially.

candidates.name: Ask Stella
candidates.description: Ask Stella is a multifamily reporting platform designed to streamline data management for property and asset managers. It integrates with various property management systems, allowing users to access detailed reports on leasing, vacancy loss, revenue trends, and inspections in plain language. The platform uses AI technology to create custom reports that are tailored to the specific needs of each client, eliminating manual workflows and reliance on third-party BI tools like Excel or spreadsheets. Key features include real-time insights, automated report generation, integration with existing property management software, and support from human analysts to enhance decision-making processes.
